<objective>
Poll every gauge post once a minute and store each reading.

Purpose: the harbour board has nothing to show until readings reach the store.
Output: the poller, the reading store with its migration, the post list and a test.
</objective>

  <verify>
    <automated>npm test -- test/intake/poll.test.ts</automated>
  </verify>
